qa_stack.profile: bring the stack up with `docker compose -f compose.yml up -d --build --wait` and drive it over http://localhost:18084; sandboxed runs reach the same URL through the forwarded port declared in qa-stack.yml
fixtures: a policy on file at a known version (POST /api/policies) to amend, to cancel, and to replay a stale write against
qa_stack.capable_of_rendering: the amendment and cancellation endpoints against the live ledger, and the edit and detail screens carrying the version through a form
qa_stack.notes: the stale-write criterion needs two writes from one reading, not a single amendment that happens to succeed
